data.title: HelloNation Article Featuring Orthodontist Dr. Ben Thornton Explains How Long Patients Should Wear a Retainer After Braces or Clear Aligners
data.description: A recent article discusses the importance of using retainers for an extended period after orthodontic treatment to prevent teeth shifting. The article, published on Oct. 16, 2026 in EUGENE, Ore., explains that patients should wear retainers for an extended period after braces or clear aligners are removed to maintain the results of the treatment. It emphasizes the need for long-term retainer use to ensure the proper alignment of teeth. The article from HelloNation provides valuable insights on the recommended duration for wearing retainers post-treatment. This information underscores the significance of ongoing retainer use in preserving the outcomes of orthodontic procedures and highlights the benefits of adhering to this practice.
